decisions.collectorChecklist: 1774 explicit rows in 17 collector families. Complete base 1-800 and Gold Hologram 1-800 remain unified, without series/range splits. Every insert, sticker, event and autograph checklist independently enumerated.
decisions.goldHologram: Verified genuine full 800-card factory-set parallel, not an ordinary-pack pull. Include for Admin pricing/images with null odds. Do not infer RC suffixes from the base issue or manufacture isolated hologram-stock parallel checklists.
decisions.pack: Standard foil model: 15 total cards, 36 packs/box. Unlike 1991, no guaranteed extra hologram sticker in every pack. Physical Jumbo was 27 cards/20 packs, not this product. Base availability flattened across low/high series according to Set Factory conventions.
decisions.odds: Published sources do not establish exact rates for ordinary-pack SP, Heroes, Williams hologram, College holograms, Williams Best or autographs. SP estimate one per three/four boxes and sticker estimate five/six per low-series box are ranges, not verified exact denominators. All insert odds remain null until Admin chooses/validates a model. No invented carryover from 1991 or default equal-series mix. Null families are collector checklists available for pricing/images but disabled for pulls.
decisions.channels: Home Run Heroes is low-series Jumbo-only and Scouting Report high-series Jumbo-only, each one per matching Jumbo pack; both null under standard-foil default. Heroes of Baseball, its three autographs and Heroes Highlights are special event-pack issues with null ordinary-pack odds. Keep their genuine distinct collector checklists.
decisions.rarity: Keep complete Heroes checklists including short-printed generic NNO headers and complete 30-card gold Team Logo family including short-printed expansion logos. Engine chooses uniformly within a family; exact historical per-card weights are not modeled. No silent split or fabricated print counts.
decisions.rookies: Canonical TCDB and separate index both report 45 candidates, not 45 verified true RCs. Exclude #12 Ted Wood (1989 Topps Big 308), #45 Mo Sanford (1991 Fleer Update U-86), #57 Dave Nilsson (1991 UD Final 25F), #58 Dmitri Young (Final 7F), #526 Frank Castillo (Final 27F), #566 Jose Melendez (1991 Donruss The Rookies 23), #621 Warren Newson (1991 Ultra Update U-17) and #625 Juan Guzman (Ultra U-60) because earlier major releases exist. Add #52 Eduardo Perez per BCP, CCC and indexed Beckett catalog. Hold #54 David Zancanaro and #69 Jon Farrell (TCDB/BCP RC/RC* vs indexed Beckett TP), and #796 Butch Henry (BCP/CCC RC vs canonical omission) without a true-RC suffix pending designation review. 36 retained source-supported suffixes in this conservative draft. No RC inferred from Rookie/Prospect/College subset labels, Gold Hologram or inserts.
decisions.catalogCorrections: Expand caption-only Bloodlines/composite checklist subjects from independent checklists and card scans. #80 depicts Keith Mitchell, not BCP Brian Mitchell. Gold #69 is Pittsburgh Pirates on the card, not the source Welland Pirates. #84 depicts Dwight Gooden and Gary Sheffield: use Mets/Brewers, corroborating affiliations with individual base cards #135/#234; Gold source blank corrected. Align player/team order on #1/#51/#81/#83. SP4 depicts Tom Selleck and Frank Thomas as fictional Yankees; no Chicago White Sox affiliation inferred.
decisions.autographs: Ted Williams #36 and Bench/Morgan #45 are each hand-numbered /2500; Bench AND Morgan both signed. Event H5/H6/H7 each /3000, no invented signed H8. BCP AU4/AU5/AU6/AU7 are catalog identifiers, not substituted for printed card numbers. Genuine pack-issued signatures have diamond reverse hologram, unsigned versions fan-shaped.
decisions.holograms: Separate 28 silver Heroes of Baseball Pennant Holograms from 30 gold Team Logo Holograms (28 franchises plus American/National League). Unnumbered logos get stable alphabetical NNO-01..NNO-28/30 VCS identifiers, not purported printed numbers. Three College holograms retain verified college/pro-team affiliations.
decisions.scope: Exclude sixteen oversized box-bottom panels (eight Williams and eight Bench/Morgan), wrapper/mail-in lithographs, promotional sheets and unverified autograph/printing variants. Factory Gold Hologram is deliberately included as a complete non-pullable collector parallel.
decisions.teams: All player, college, franchise and cross-sport subjects have explicit verified affiliations. Two genuine league logo subjects use American League/National League. Eight base and eight Gold generic checklists intentionally blank. Two generic Heroes header cards have no franchise and require pending-team staging. No invented MLB team.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft only. Pricing, images, generic-header team review, all exact insert odds/pack QA and three disputed rookie designations pending. No production database modification or deployment.
decisions.rookieBlocker: Beckett indexed set metadata reports 31 RCs, while TCDB has 45 candidates. Direct Beckett set/marketplace retrieval redirects to maintenance rather than card data; a full authoritative card-by-card reconciliation could not be completed. Do not claim that 36 retained suffixes are a resolved Beckett-standard count. Earlier-release exclusions and three explicit disputed cards are documented; rookie review remains PENDING before release.
